title: Can I Beat Every Advanced Bot?
summary: Speedrun with a running timer: beat every chess.com Advanced bot in rating order as fast as possible, normal chess: Wendy (1500), Pablo (1600), Arthur (1700), Lorenzo (1800), Miguel (1900), Lee (2000), Manuel (2100). He beats the first six but loses to Manuel (2100) when a pawn can't be stopped, resigning and ending the run.
rules: Play the advanced bots in rising rating; a running speedrun timer counts total time.
A loss ends the run (he resigns vs Manuel and stops).
win_condition: Beat all seven advanced bots; he failed at Manuel (2100).

opponent.name: chess.com Advanced bots: Wendy 1500, Pablo 1600, Arthur 1700, Lorenzo 1800, Miguel 1900, Lee 2000, Manuel 2100
opponent.avatar_description: Small cartoon portraits of each bot persona; remake: seven original cartoon heads.

board.theme_notes: chess.com brown board with a large elapsed speedrun timer (e.g. 6:04.65, 15:17).

events: Speedrun timer runs across all games; bot ladder advances on each win.
